LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_GroupReturnAn: Coming home and loading by hand
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingLoadin: Colonists who are not going with a caravan help load it, through the Load column in the Work tab. Turn this off to go back to vanilla, where only the pawns going load the caravan, with some help from haulers when it has a pack animal or prisoner with room.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingColoni: Helpers may put items into the inventory of colonists who are going, when no pack animal or prisoner in the caravan has room. Without this, a caravan of colonists alone gets no help.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingEarlyL: Helpers start loading animals that are already tied at the hitching spot while the rest are still being brought over.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingHelper: Colonists with Load enabled lead pen animals that are going with the caravan to the hitching spot.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingLeadsS: A colonist leading animals for a forming caravan keeps hold of them when drafted. Drafted colonists can also drop a lead, or take the lead of a caravan animal nobody is holding.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingAreaAw: The caravan leaves from a map edge inside the allowed area of every pawn that is restricted to one. If no such edge exists, the caravan packs and then waits where it gathered, with an alert, until there is one.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingThreat: The caravan prefers an exit away from hostile pawns, and picks another one while forming if a threat appears near the one it chose.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingLeaveF: Gives a drafted colonist in a forming caravan, standing near the map edge, a button that sends the caravan off from that edge.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingDepart: Forcing a caravan to depart lists the downed pawns and babies nobody is carrying, who would be left behind.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingThreat: How close a hostile pawn has to be to an exit, in cells, for the exit to count as threatened.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingRouteT: How close a hostile pawn has to be to the way out, in cells, for that way out to count as threatened.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingListAn: The caravan formation window lists items your animals are already carrying, so they can go with the caravan instead of being unloaded. The other cargo options need this one.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingCargoI: Marks animals that are already carrying cargo in the caravan formation window. The tooltip lists what they carry.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingAutoAd: Selecting an animal that carries cargo adds its cargo to the caravan, and deselecting it takes the cargo off again.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingKeepLo: Animals going with the caravan keep the cargo that is going too, and unload only what is not.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingTransf: Colonists move cargo from animals that are staying onto animals that are going.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingProtec: Cargo stays on the caravan's list when the animal carrying it is removed from the caravan or goes down, and pawns outside the caravan do not eat the caravan's food.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingInstan: Cargo that is not going is dropped beside the animal straight away, instead of being unloaded one stack at a time. While Bulk Load For Transporters is active this always happens, because that mod replaces unloading.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingComple: Loading does not finish while items on the list are still lying on the ground. Items nobody can reach are dropped from the list after the grace period below. If nothing at all is loaded for twice that long, everything still on the list is dropped.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingManife: When an item on the list is eaten, destroyed or merged into another stack, the caravan takes an identical stack instead. What it cannot replace is dropped from the list with a message.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingStallR: Shows what a forming caravan is waiting for, on its pawns' inspect pane and in a tab, and raises an alert when it has made no progress for a while.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingComple: How long an item nobody can reach holds up loading before it is dropped from the list.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingStallA: How long a forming caravan can go without progress before the alert appears.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingUnload: Pack animals that come home with a caravan are led to a stockpile, unloaded there and then taken to their pen, instead of being unloaded inside the pen one stack at a time.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingLoadOn: Loading an item onto a forming caravan by hand fills pack animals that have room first, then the colonist doing it, then the other colonists going.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SettingManual: Items loaded by hand count towards the caravan's list, so they are not loaded a second time.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_NoCarrier: nobody in the caravan can take it
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_LoadingSkippe: Nobody in the forming caravan could take some items for {0}, so it will leave without them: {1}.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_LoadingGaveUp: The forming caravan loaded nothing for {0}, so it will leave without: {1}.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_SpotOutsideAr: the caravan's spot is outside the allowed area
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_DropLeadDesc: Let go of an animal this colonist is leading. With several held, choose which, or let go of them all.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_LeadReleasedH: {0} let go of {1}, which is too hungry to keep following.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_LeadReleasedT: {0} let go of {1}, which is too tired to keep following.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_LeadsDroppedO: {0} let go of the animals. Leads are kept only while drafted, or while leading animals to the caravan's spot or its exit.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_LeadRecollect: {0} cannot reach the caravan's exit by itself, so the caravan is collecting its animals again.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_ExitHeld: No map edge the caravan can reach is inside the allowed area of every pawn going with it, so it waits where it gathered until there is one.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_ExitReleased: The caravan can now leave by a map edge inside every allowed area, so it stops waiting.
LanguageData.CaravansCriticallyEnhanced_ExitMoved: The caravan's exit moved to stay inside the allowed area of every pawn going with it.
